widgets.name: Audio control
widgets.author: Raintile
widgets.description: The sound devices of the PC with their volume (a click makes one the default), or the volume of each program as in Windows' volume mixer: the tile's widget setting says which, so two tiles can show one each. Give the tile more cells for more rows.

widgets.name: Big clock
widgets.author: Raintile
widgets.description: The time in big letters, with the day and the date. It fills the tile.

widgets.name: Modrinth instances
widgets.author: Raintile
widgets.description: Your Modrinth App instances with their icons, the last played first: click one to start it. Give the tile more cells for more rows.

widgets.name: Steam achievements
widgets.author: Raintile
widgets.description: The achievements of the Steam game played last, or of the game you choose (the tile's widget setting: its app id): how many are unlocked, the last ones, the easiest locked ones. Needs your Steam Web API key (Options > Widgets > Steam achievements).

widgets.name: Now Playing
widgets.author: Raintile
widgets.description: What any player is playing (Spotify, YouTube in a browser, the Media Player...), as Windows shows it over the volume: the cover fills the tile, the controls and the times show with the mouse or the pad on it, a bar along the bottom shows the time. No plugin or extension needed.

widgets.name: Spotify
widgets.author: Raintile
widgets.description: The song playing in Spotify: its cover fills the tile, the controls (play, previous, next, the heart, open Spotify) and the times show with the mouse or the pad on it, a bar along the bottom shows the time. Needs Spicetify with its WebNowPlaying extension.
